ctx.x: Yeah, he was always like that. He was always like that. And he used to tell me some stories about his father and he couldn't read and his sister played tenor. See, when I first met him, his sister played tenor and he played alto and Lee played drums. And the name of the act was Pap, Sis and Bub. They played Sherman and he was playing alto then. And that's during the time -- this must be close -- I can't pinpoint it, but it was during the time that I heard the Whiteman band and I met Bix and all of them. They…

things would always come to Sherman, you know, and all the bands would come there to play and I'd catch all of them. But anyway, I was with him -- he asked me, says, "How are you going home?" It was hard to get back to New York, Gary. You had to go to Providence and wait a long time and take a bus to Providence and wait and maybe miss a train, then catch a train from Providence to New York. So he was up there, he and his lady, he had his lady and a friend that had driven him there and a Cadillac. He's sitting in…
